name: Ferienwohnung Streif
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Streif provides pleasant living space for families and couples, featuring bright rooms and views of the Kaiser mountains.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, the Kaiser valley ascent, and the Hallo du leisure complex are all reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Streif in Ebbs offers family comfort at the foot of the Zahmer Kaiser in Kufsteinerland.
